en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a scenic landscape with two prominent castles or ruins perched on separate hills. The left side shows a large castle on a steep cliff surrounded by dense forest, while the right side displays two towers atop another hill. Below, a river winds through the valley. The image has a painterly quality, typical of early colorized postcards. At the bottom, the text 'RUDELSBURG UND SAALECK.' is printed.
